rows.grounds: present passive participle describing one undergoing cutting
optative expressing potential or counterfactual result
compound indicating one who has reached that state
compound indicating one whose mind is absorbed in that

items.question: Does absorption in that state prevent harm even when the body is being cut?
premises: A person may be physically subjected to cutting.
A person can be gone to that state.
A person can have the mind fixed on that state.
items.inference: One who has reached that state and whose mind is fixed on it is not truly cut even while being cut.
uncertainties: The referent of 'that' (tad) depends on the preceding context.
items.plain_english: Just as one who has reached that state and whose mind is fixed on it, even while being cut, is not cut.
